source_record.subject: Re: QH 207 interpretive follow-up — ritual deposition and Osiris “re-membering”

custody_findings.rights_note: Some data are protected by copyrights of other institutions; publication of potential results would require clarification with the relevant rights holders.

publication_scope_from_fitzenreiter.no_other_topic_publications_claim: Fitzenreiter states he has not published other works on this topic beyond these.
publication_scope_from_fitzenreiter.material_analyses: He states the material analyses conducted at the time were published in full in Gusswerkstatt (2016).
publication_scope_from_fitzenreiter.imaging_models: He states the models created using imaging techniques and supplied by BAM were published in Gusswerkstatt (2016).

interpretive_feedback.exact_effect: Fitzenreiter declines to judge that the Elephantine context carries particular weight.
counterevidence_or_context: The assemblage included objects depicting other deities, so the presumed foundry was not focused only on Osirian ritual support.
Osiris representations form the majority of material at Late Period sites generally, so Osiris predominance at QH207 is unlikely to be unique to Elephantine.
interpretive_feedback.consequence: This weakens any attempt to infer an Elephantine-specific ritual cause merely from the high frequency of Osiris objects. It does not falsify the 2022 local ritual hypothesis.

relation_to_prior_replies.rademakers: Independent convergence on Bonn as current data/material route.
relation_to_prior_replies.effect: Two separate project participants now point the research route toward Bonn rather than themselves.
relation_to_prior_replies.independence_caution: This is independent contact convergence on custody/referral, not independent scientific replication of the ritual interpretation.

next_action.primary: Continue Förster/Bonn route for surviving compositional data QH207/39 + /40, object-specific mapping, working photographs/project archive and access/copyright conditions.
next_action.do_not: Do not send Fitzenreiter a repeat evidence request unless a genuinely new question arises.

canonical_seal: BONN HOLDS THE MATERIAL; FITZENREITER DOES NOT. ELEPHANTINE-SPECIFIC CAUSAL WEIGHT REMAINS OPEN AND NOW HAS A DIRECT AUTHOR CAUTION.
